# Weather

> The API reference of Weather.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless an operation's page says it takes no credential. Send `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [CreateCity](src/operations/API_CreateCity.md): `POST /cities`.
- [GetCity](src/operations/API_GetCity.md): `GET /cities/{cityId}`.
- [GetCityPhoto](src/operations/API_GetCityPhoto.md): `GET /cities/{cityId}/photo`.
- [ListCities](src/operations/API_ListCities.md): `GET /cities`.
- [Ping](src/operations/API_Ping.md): `GET /ping`. Deprecated.
- [PutCityPhoto](src/operations/API_PutCityPhoto.md): `PUT /cities/{cityId}/photo`. Stores a city\'s photo exactly as sent\.

## Data types

- [CityId](src/shapes/CityId.md): string.
- [CityName](src/shapes/CityName.md): string.
- [CitySummaries](src/shapes/CitySummaries.md): list.
- [CitySummary](src/shapes/CitySummary.md): structure.
- [ConflictError](src/shapes/ConflictError.md): error, HTTP 409.
- [Coordinates](src/shapes/Coordinates.md): structure.
- [CreateCityInput](src/shapes/CreateCityInput.md): structure.
- [CreateCityOutput](src/shapes/CreateCityOutput.md): structure.
- [DateTime](src/shapes/DateTime.md): timestamp.
- [Forecast](src/shapes/Forecast.md): map.
- [GetCityInput](src/shapes/GetCityInput.md): structure.
- [GetCityOutput](src/shapes/GetCityOutput.md): structure.
- [GetCityPhotoInput](src/shapes/GetCityPhotoInput.md): structure.
- [GetCityPhotoOutput](src/shapes/GetCityPhotoOutput.md): structure.
- [ListCitiesInput](src/shapes/ListCitiesInput.md): structure.
- [ListCitiesOutput](src/shapes/ListCitiesOutput.md): structure.
- [Location](src/shapes/Location.md): union.
- [NotFoundError](src/shapes/NotFoundError.md): error, HTTP 404.
- [Photo](src/shapes/Photo.md): blob. A photo\, carried unparsed\.
- [PhotoSummary](src/shapes/PhotoSummary.md): structure.
- [PutCityPhotoInput](src/shapes/PutCityPhotoInput.md): structure.
- [PutCityPhotoOutput](src/shapes/PutCityPhotoOutput.md): structure.
- [Sky](src/shapes/Sky.md): enum.
- [Tags](src/shapes/Tags.md): list.
- [ThrottlingError](src/shapes/ThrottlingError.md): error, HTTP 429.
- [Thumbnail](src/shapes/Thumbnail.md): blob. The photo\'s first bytes\: base64 in JSON\.
- [ValidationError](src/shapes/ValidationError.md): error, HTTP 400.
- [ValidationField](src/shapes/ValidationField.md): structure.
- [ValidationFieldList](src/shapes/ValidationFieldList.md): list.
- [ValidationReason](src/shapes/ValidationReason.md): enum.
